section.content: The utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument, relate to the gene field of drawing, including place the platform, centrifuge and setting are used for carrying out the centre gripping subassembly fixed to centrifuge at the place the platform top, the place the platform top is provided with centrifuge, a plurality of connecting rods of place the platform bottom fixedly connected with, the place the platform bottom is provided with a plurality of supporting shoes, the cushion chamber has all been seted up to a plurality of supporting shoes inside, the inside gasbag that is provided with of cushion chamber, the through-hole has all been seted up at a plurality of supporting shoe tops, a plurality of connecting rod bottoms are equallyd divide and are do not run through the through-hole and extend to the cushion chamber inside, the equal fixedly connected with stopper in a plurality of connecting rod bottoms, the centre gripping subassembly includes the movable slot, the screw thread lead screw, the fixed plate, trompil and nut. This kind of instrument can carry out the centre gripping to centrifuge through the use of activity groove, screw lead screw, fixed plate, trompil and nut and fix, secondly, through the use of connecting rod, supporting shoe, cushion chamber, gasbag, through-hole and stopper, can cushion centrifuge.

本实用新型提供了一种生物基因提取仪器，涉及基因提取领域，包括放置平台、离心机和设置在放置平台顶部用于对离心机进行固定的夹持组件，放置平台顶部设置有离心机，放置平台底部固定连接有多个连接杆，放置平台底部设置有多个支撑块，多个支撑块内部均开设有缓冲腔，缓冲腔内部设置有气囊，多个支撑块顶部均开设有通孔，多个连接杆底端均分别贯穿通孔延伸至缓冲腔内部，多个连接杆底端均固定连接有限位块，夹持组件包括活动槽、螺纹丝杆、固定板、开孔和螺母。该种仪器通过活动槽、螺纹丝杆、固定板、开孔和螺母的使用，能够对离心机进行夹持固定，其次，通过连接杆、支撑块、缓冲腔、气囊、通孔和限位块的使用，能够对离心机进行缓冲。

Biological gene extraction instrumentTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene extraction technical field specifically is a biological gene draws instrument.

Background

The gene is a DNA fragment with genetic effect, supports the basic structure and performance of life, stores all information of the processes of race, blood type, inoculation, growth, apoptosis and the like of life and is an intrinsic factor determining the health of life, therefore, the gene has dual properties of material property and information property, a centrifugal machine is a machine for separating each component in liquid and solid particles or a mixture of liquid and liquid by using centrifugal force, and the centrifugal machine is also one of extraction means in the aspect of gene extraction.

But centrifuge can send vibrations when the operation, and centrifuge's vibrations can make the centrifuge body begin to squint, can touch other equipment when leading to centrifuge skew easily, makes other equipment empty easily to damage, simultaneously, centrifuge's vibrations also can lead to fixed the appearance that centrifuge itself goes on not hard up, make centrifuge itself appear turning on one's side when the operation, lead to centrifuge itself to appear damaging.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims at solving the shortcoming that exists among the background art, provide a biological gene and draw instrument, through the use of activity groove, screw lead screw, fixed plate, trompil and nut, can carry out the centre gripping to centrifuge and fix, secondly, through the use of connecting rod, supporting shoe, cushion chamber, gasbag, through-hole and stopper, can cushion centrifuge.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model provides a technical scheme, a biological gene extraction instrument, which comprises a placing platform, a centrifuge and a clamping component arranged on the top of the placing platform and used for fixing the centrifuge;

the top of the placing platform is provided with a centrifuge, the bottom of the placing platform is fixedly connected with a plurality of connecting rods, the bottom of the placing platform is provided with a plurality of supporting blocks, buffering cavities are formed in the supporting blocks, air bags are arranged in the buffering cavities, through holes are formed in the tops of the supporting blocks, the bottoms of the connecting rods respectively penetrate through the through holes and extend into the buffering cavities, and limiting blocks are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the connecting rods;

the clamping assembly comprises a movable groove, a threaded screw rod, a fixing plate, an opening and a nut, wherein the two movable grooves and the two movable grooves are formed in the top of the placing platform, the threaded screw rod is arranged inside each movable groove, the fixing plate is arranged on the surface of the threaded screw rod, the opening is formed in one side of the fixing plate, and the nut is connected to the surface of the threaded screw rod through threaded engagement.

Further, the heat dissipation pipeline is arranged at the axis of the placing platform, a support is arranged inside the heat dissipation pipeline, and a blower is arranged at the bottom of the support.

Further, the equal fixedly connected with spliced pole in centrifuge both sides, the draw-in groove has all been seted up to spliced pole top and bottom, the inside ejecting spring that is provided with of draw-in groove, the one end fixedly connected with liftout plate that the draw-in groove inner wall was kept away from to ejecting spring, a fixedly connected with fixture block of ejecting spring is kept away from to the liftout plate.

Furthermore, the surface of the connecting column is provided with a handle, fixing holes are formed in two sides of the handle, and one end, far away from the centrifugal machine, of the connecting column penetrates through the fixing holes.

Further, a heat dissipation window is arranged at the bottom of the centrifuge.

Furthermore, the front surface of the centrifuge is provided with a control panel, and the centrifuge is electrically connected with the control panel.

Further, the storage battery is arranged at the top of the placing platform and is electrically connected with the centrifuge and the blower respectively.

The utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument has following beneficial effect:

1. the utility model has the advantages of, through the use of activity groove, screw lead screw, fixed plate, trompil and nut, can carry out the centre gripping to centrifuge fixed for centrifuge can not be because of not fixing the condition of the skew that takes place when the operation.

2. Secondly, through the use of connecting rod, supporting shoe, cushion chamber, gasbag, through-hole and stopper, can cushion centrifuge for centrifuge can lead to appearing not hard up the condition of turning on one's side at last with the fixed of platform because of the vibrations that self sent when the operation.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic view of the overall structure of the present invention.

Fig. 2 is a sectional view of the overall structure of the present invention.

In FIGS. 1-4: 1. placing a platform; 101. a connecting rod; 102. a support block; 103. a buffer chamber; 104. an air bag; 105. a through hole; 106. a limiting block; 107. a storage battery; 2. a centrifuge; 201. connecting columns; 202. a card slot; 203. ejecting a spring; 204. ejecting the plate; 205. a clamping block; 206. a handle; 207. a fixing hole; 208. a heat dissipation window; 209. a control panel; 3. a movable groove; 301. a threaded lead screw; 302. a fixing plate; 303. opening a hole; 304. a nut; 4. a heat dissipation pipe; 401. a support; 402. an air blower.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

The embodiment is as follows:

referring to figures 1-4 of the drawings,

the biological gene extraction instrument provided by the embodiment comprises a placing platform 1, a centrifuge 2 and a clamping component which is arranged at the top of the placing platform 1 and used for fixing the centrifuge 2;

the centrifuge 2 is arranged at the top of the placing platform 1, the connecting rods 101 are fixedly connected to the bottom of the placing platform 1, the supporting blocks 102 are arranged at the bottom of the placing platform 1, the buffer cavities 103 are formed in the supporting blocks 102, the air bags 104 are arranged in the buffer cavities 103, through holes 105 are formed in the tops of the supporting blocks 102, the bottom ends of the connecting rods 101 respectively penetrate through the through holes 105 and extend into the buffer cavities 103, and the bottom ends of the connecting rods 101 are fixedly connected with the limiting blocks 106;

the centre gripping subassembly includes activity groove 3, screw lead screw 301, fixed plate 302, trompil 303 and nut 304, and two activity grooves 3 have been seted up at 1 top of place the platform, and two activity groove 3 insides all are provided with screw lead screw 301, and screw lead screw 301 surface is provided with fixed plate 302, and trompil 303 has been seted up to fixed plate 302 one side, and screw lead screw 301 surface is connected with nut 304 through the thread engagement.

Further, place platform 1 axle center department has seted up heat dissipation pipeline 4, and heat dissipation pipeline 4 is inside to be provided with support 401, and support 401 bottom is provided with hair-dryer 402, and the heat of 2 inside operations of centrifuge can enter into heat dissipation pipeline 4 from heat dissipation window 208 inside, and battery 107 can provide electric power for the start-up of hair-dryer 402, will enter into the heat of heat dissipation pipeline 4 after hair-dryer 402 starts and blow out heat dissipation pipeline 4 to can dispel the heat to centrifuge 2 fast.

Furthermore, connecting columns 201 are fixedly connected to two sides of the centrifuge 2, clamping grooves 202 are formed in the top and the bottom of the connecting columns 201, an ejecting spring 203 is arranged in each clamping groove 202, an ejecting plate 204 is fixedly connected to one end, away from the inner wall of each clamping groove 202, of each ejecting spring 203, a clamping block 205 is fixedly connected to one portion, away from the ejecting spring 203, of each ejecting plate 204, when the pull handle 206 needs to be taken out, the clamping block 205 is pressed to move into the clamping groove 202, the ejecting plate 204 is ejected into the clamping groove 202 when the clamping block 205 moves into the clamping groove 202, the ejecting plate 204 moves into the clamping groove 202 after being ejected, the ejecting spring 203 is extruded, the extruded ejecting spring 203 is gradually compressed, the clamping block 205 can completely enter the clamping groove 202, the pull handle 206 is taken down after the clamping block 205 enters the clamping groove 202, and accordingly the fixing of the pull handle 206 and the centrifuge 2 is released, after the handle 206 is removed, the ejecting spring 203 starts to recover, the elastic force of the ejecting spring 203 during recovery pushes the ejecting plate 204 back to the original position, and the ejecting plate 204 drives the fixture block 205 to move back to the original position together when being ejected.

Further, the surface of the connecting column 201 is provided with a handle 206, fixing holes 207 have been all seted up on both sides of the handle 206, one end of the connecting column 201, which is far away from the centrifuge 2, penetrates through the fixing hole 207, the fixing hole 207 is aligned with the connecting column 201 when the handle 206 is required to be installed, the handle 206 is pushed after alignment, the inner wall of the fixing hole 207 can push the fixture block 205 back to the inside of the clamping groove 202 when the handle 206 is pushed, the ejection spring 203 is extruded when the fixture block 205 enters the clamping groove 202, so that the ejection spring 203 becomes a compressed shape, after the fixing hole 207 passes through the clamping groove 202, the ejection spring 203 starts to recover to eject the fixture block 205 out of the clamping groove 202, and therefore the handle 206 is fixed.

Further, a heat radiation window 208 is arranged at the bottom of the centrifuge 2, when the centrifuge 2 centrifuges the extract, the interior will start to generate heat, and the centrifuge 2 will radiate the heat from the heat radiation window 208 to the interior of the heat radiation pipe 4.

Further, centrifuge 2 openly is provided with control panel 209, centrifuge 2 and control panel 209 electric connection, and control panel 209 can control centrifuge 2's start-up, starts centrifuge 2 through control panel 209 and makes centrifuge 2 carry out centrifugal extraction to the extract.

Further, a storage battery 107 is arranged on the top of the placing platform 1, the storage battery 107 is electrically connected with the centrifuge 2 and the blower 402 respectively, and the storage battery 107 can provide power for starting the centrifuge 2 and the blower 402.

When the utility model is used, the centrifuge 2 is placed on the top of the placing platform 1, the fixing plate 302 is pushed towards the centrifuge 2, one side of the fixing plate 302 close to the centrifuge 2 is contacted with the centrifuge 2, after the fixing plate 302 is contacted with the centrifuge 2, the nut 304 is grasped and then rotated, the nut 304 is grasped and rotated, the nut 304 is connected with the thread of the thread screw 301 in a meshed manner to move towards the fixing plate 302, the nut 304 is continuously moved after being contacted with one side of the fixing plate 302, the nut 304 is pressed against the fixing plate 302, the fixing plate 302 is pressed against the centrifuge 2 after being extruded, thereby clamping and fixing the centrifuge 2, when the extract is centrifuged, the fixture block 205 is pressed down, the fixture block 205 is moved towards the inside of the clamping groove 202, the ejector plate 204 is pushed towards the inside of the clamping groove 202 when the fixture block 205 is moved towards the inside of the clamping groove 202, the ejecting plate 204 is pushed to move towards the inside of the clamping groove 202 and simultaneously extrudes the ejecting spring 203, the extruded ejecting spring 203 gradually becomes a compressed shape, so that the clamping block 205 can completely enter the inside of the clamping groove 202, the clamping block 205 enters the inside of the clamping groove 202 and then the handle 206 is taken down, so that the fixing of the handle 206 and the centrifuge 2 is released, after the handle 206 is taken down, the ejecting spring 203 starts to recover, the ejecting plate 204 is ejected to the original position by the elastic force when the ejecting spring 203 recovers, the ejecting plate 204 drives the clamping block 205 to move back to the original position when being ejected, the extract is put into the centrifuge 2, the centrifuge 2 is started through the control panel 209 so that the centrifuge 2 centrifugally extracts, the inside of the centrifuge 2 generates heat when centrifuging the extract, the centrifuge 2 emits the heat from the heat radiating window 208 to the inside of the heat radiating pipe 4, after the heat enters the heat dissipation pipe 4, the storage battery 107 provides electric power for the start of the blower 402, the heat entering the heat dissipation pipe 4 is blown out of the heat dissipation pipe 4 after the blower 402 is started, so that the centrifuge 2 can be rapidly cooled, meanwhile, the centrifuge 2 can emit large vibration during operation, the impact force generated by the vibration of the centrifuge 2 can be transmitted to the placing platform 1, the placing platform 1 pushes the connecting rod 101 downwards after being stressed, so that the connecting rod 101 extrudes the limit block 106 towards the air bag 104, the air inside the air bag 104 after being extruded can flow towards the non-extruded side, when the impact force is not enough to enable the connecting rod 101 to continuously extrude the air bag 104, at the moment, the air inside the air bag 104 can flow into the original area, so that the limit block 106 is pushed back to the original position, the centrifuge 2 is buffered, and when the centrifuge 2 needs to be carried, aim at spliced pole 201 with fixed orifices 207, push handle 206 after the alignment, the inner wall of fixed orifices 207 can push fixture block 205 back to inside the draw-in groove 202 when pushing handle 206, push out spring 203 and extrude when fixture block 205 gets into draw-in groove 202, make ejecting spring 203 become the compression form, fixed orifices 207 passes through behind the draw-in groove 202, ejecting spring 203 begins to recover ejecting draw-in groove 202 with fixture block 205, thereby fix handle 206, can carry out the centre gripping to centrifuge 2 through above structure and fix and can cushion the vibrations that centrifuge 2 produced.

The above is only the preferred embodiment of the present invention, and it should be noted that, for those skilled in the art, without departing from the concept of the present invention, several modifications and improvements can be made, which should also be regarded as the protection scope of the present invention, and these will not affect the effect of the implementation of the present invention and the practicability of the patent.
